import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
tf.get_logger().setLevel("ERROR")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


def extract_f27_features_with_positions(df, col="f_27"):
    df = df.copy()
    df["f27_len"] = df[col].str.len()
    df["f27_unique"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))

    for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
        df[f"f27_{char}_count"] = df[col].str.count(char)

    for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
        first_occ = df[col].str.find(char).values
        df[f"f27_{char}_first"] = np.where(first_occ == -1, -1, first_occ)
        last_occ = df[col].str.rfind(char).values
        df[f"f27_{char}_last"] = np.where(last_occ == -1, -1, last_occ)

    char_list = list("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
    first_cols = [f"f27_{ch}_first" for ch in char_list]
    last_cols = [f"f27_{ch}_last" for ch in char_list]
    df["f27_max_first_pos"] = df[first_cols].max(axis=1)
    df["f27_min_last_pos"] = df[last_cols].min(axis=1)
    df["f27_avg_first_pos"] = df[first_cols].replace(-1, np.nan).mean(axis=1).fillna(-1)
    df["f27_avg_last_pos"] = df[last_cols].replace(-1, np.nan).mean(axis=1).fillna(-1)

    return df


# Process train and test data
train = extract_f27_features_with_positions(train)
test = extract_f27_features_with_positions(test)

# Add aggregate character stats
char_cols = [
    col
    for col in train.columns
    if col.startswith("f27_") and len(col) == 8 and col.endswith("_count")
]
train["f27_total_counts"] = train[char_cols].sum(axis=1)
test["f27_total_counts"] = test[char_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Polynomial features for continuous columns
poly_cols = ["f_00", "f_01", "f_02", "f_03", "f_19", "f_20", "f_28"]
train_poly = train[poly_cols].values
test_poly = test[poly_cols].values

poly_features_train = []
poly_features_test = []
for i in range(len(poly_cols)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(poly_cols)):
        poly_features_train.append(train_poly[:, i] * train_poly[:, j])
        poly_features_test.append(test_poly[:, i] * test_poly[:, j])

train_poly_added = pd.DataFrame(
    np.column_stack(poly_features_train),
    columns=[
        f"{poly_cols[i]}_{poly_cols[j]}"
        for i in range(len(poly_cols))
        for j in range(i + 1, len(poly_cols))
    ],
)
test_poly_added = pd.DataFrame(
    np.column_stack(poly_features_test),
    columns=[
        f"{poly_cols[i]}_{poly_cols[j]}"
        for i in range(len(poly_cols))
        for j in range(i + 1, len(poly_cols))
    ],
)

train = pd.concat([train.reset_index(drop=True), train_poly_added], axis=1)
test = pd.concat([test.reset_index(drop=True), test_poly_added], axis=1)

# Target encode the long categorical column f_27
f_27_freq = train["f_27"].map(train["f_27"].value_counts(normalize=True))
test["f_27_freq"] = test["f_27"].map(train["f_27"].value_counts(normalize=True))
f_27_mean = train.groupby("f_27")["target"].mean()
train["f_27_target_enc"] = train["f_27"].map(f_27_mean)
test["f_27_target_enc"] = test["f_27"].map(f_27_mean)
train["f_27_target_enc"].fillna(0.5, inplace=True)
test["f_27_target_enc"].fillna(0.5, inplace=True)

# Identify feature columns
exclude_cols = ["id", "target", "f_27"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

# Prepare features
X = train[feature_cols].copy()
y = train["target"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].copy()

# Convert to numeric and fill missing
for col in feature_cols:
    if X[col].dtype == "object":
        X[col] = pd.to_numeric(X[col], errors="coerce")
        X_test[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_test[col], errors="coerce")
    X[col] = X[col].fillna(0)
    X_test[col] = X_test[col].fillna(0)

# Scale continuous features (all are numeric after conversion)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Split for validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_scaled, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)


# Build a DNN model
def create_model(input_dim):
    model = keras.Sequential(
        [
            layers.Input(shape=(input_dim,)),
            layers.Dense(256, activation="relu"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.3),
            layers.Dense(128, activation="relu"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.3),
            layers.Dense(64, activation="relu"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.2),
            layers.Dense(1, activation="sigmoid"),
        ]
    )
    model.compile(
        optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=0.001),
        loss="binary_crossentropy",
        metrics=["AUC"],
    )
    return model


# Train model with early stopping
model = create_model(X_train.shape[1])

early_stopping = keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
    monitor="val_auc", patience=30, restore_best_weights=True, verbose=0
)

history = model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    validation_data=(X_val, y_val),
    epochs=200,
    batch_size=1024,
    callbacks=[early_stopping],
    verbose=0,
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, verbose=0).flatten()
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test_scaled, verbose=0).flatten()

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
